name: 43257-longprefill-gemma4e4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one eighth of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine on one node; no router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: multimodal instruct decoder (Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration, model_type gemma4), FP8 W8A8 compressed-tensors: a 42-layer text decoder plus a vision and an audio tower, one 13.3 GB safetensors shard, public and ungated.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, 30 requests, 10% warmup, 10% cooldown, 1800 s safety cap, static seed 43257; 26 requests are measured.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, 100000 prompt tokens in and exactly 1 token out per request, single turn, text only, fixed length on both ends (min == max).
purpose: A document analysis assistant digesting 100,000-token filings one at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
# `vllm serve --config` for this setup: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one in-process engine.
model: prithivMLmods/gemma-4-E4B-it-FP8

# The checkpoint's own quantization config carries no `kv_cache_scheme`, so an FP8 KV cache has to
# be asked for here -- nothing selects it implicitly.
kv-cache-dtype: fp8

# Named verbatim in the source's own benchmark setup line and carried over rather than left to
# resolution. This checkpoint declares two head dimensions (a sliding-window one and a larger
# global one), and on Hopper an unpinned engine routes that combination onto a path the source did
# not measure -- one the source states outright is incompatible with an FP8 KV cache. Pinning
# restores the stated configuration; it does not create it.
attention-backend: TRITON_ATTN

# The checkpoint's own window, taken as is rather than trimmed to the workload's 100001 tokens.
max-model-len: 131072
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
